template: Work outward from the innermost shape to the outermost: count how many shapes are nested inside one another, decide whether each step shrinks by roughly the same factor or by a changing one, and estimate through how many degrees the innermost shape has been turned relative to the outermost, giving a value from 0 to 120 degrees to the nearest 10. State your conclusion, justify it by describing how you matched corresponding corners between the innermost and outermost shapes, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: explicit semantic dependency rules plus empirical conditional-variation checks for suspected relationships; the line-order parity rule is evaluated over all 3000 source records

shape_count.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

human_constant_vs_changing_20.review_method: manual render-only judgment before comparison with stored factor progression

special_checks.span_threshold_disposition: retained at 1.35 because manual agreement was 95%
